name: fivebot-v2
description: FiveBot v2 - Advanced Discord Bot Manager

scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && npm run start:dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.start: concurrently "cd backend && npm start" "cd frontend && npm start"
scripts.setup: npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend && npm run setup:bot
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:reset: cd backend && npx prisma migrate reset
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend

author: FiveBot Team
